texts.title_ja: 『ベーオウルフ』冒頭
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Hwæt! We Gardena in geardagum,
þeodcyninga, þrym gefrunon,
hu ða æþelingas ellen fremedon.

texts.title_ja: 古英語『ロッドの夢』冒頭
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Hwæt! Ic swefna cyst secgan wylle,
hwæt me gemætte to midre nihte

texts.title_ja: 古英語『放浪者』冒頭
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Mæg ic be me sylfum soðgied wrecan,
siþas secgan, hu ic geswincdagum

texts.title_ja: 『真珠』冒頭（中英語）
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Perle, plesaunte to prynces paye
To clanly clos in golde so clere
Oute of oryent, I hardyly saye

texts.title_original: Sir Gawain and the Green Knight 1-19
texts.title_ja: 『サー・ガウェインと緑の騎士』冒頭
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Siþen þe sege and þe assaut watz sesed at Troye,
Þe borȝ brittened and brent to brondez and askez

texts.title_ja: クレチアン・ド・トロワ『イヴァン』冒頭
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Artus, li boens rois de Bretaingne,
La cui proesce nos enseigne

texts.title_ja: マリー・ド・フランス『短歌物語』序
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Ki Deus ad duné escïence
E de parler bone eloquence

texts.title_original: Bernart de Ventadorn, Can vei la lauzeta
texts.title_ja: ベルナール・ド・ヴァンタドゥール「ひばりが翼を打つを見たとき」
texts.form_genre: トルバドゥール抒情詩
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Can vei la lauzeta mover
De joi sas alas contra·l rai

texts.title_original: Walther von der Vogelweide, Under der linden
texts.title_ja: ヴァルター・フォン・デア・フォーゲルヴァイデ「菩提樹のもとで」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Under der linden
an der heide,
dâ unser zweier bette was

texts.title_ja: ダンテ『地獄篇』第3歌「地獄門」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Per me si va ne la città dolente,
per me si va ne l'etterno dolore,
per me si va tra la perduta gente.

texts.title_ja: ダンテ『地獄篇』第5歌「フランチェスカ」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Amor, ch'al cor gentil ratto s'apprende,
prese costui de la bella persona
che mi fu tolta

texts.title_ja: ペトラルカ『カンツォニエーレ』134「平和を見つけられず」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Pace non trovo, et non ò da far guerra;
e temo, et spero; et ardo, et son un ghiaccio

texts.title_ja: カヴァルカンティ「貴婦人が私に問う」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Donna me prega, perché voglio dire
d'un accidente che sovente è fero

texts.title_ja: スペンサー『アモレッティ』I
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Happy ye leaves when as those lilly hands,
Which hold my life in their dead doing might,
Shall handle you and hold in loves soft bands,
Lyke captives trembling at the victors sight.

texts.title_ja: シドニー『アストロフィルとステラ』1
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Loving in truth, and fain in verse my love to show,
That she, dear she, might take some pleasure of my pain

texts.title_ja: マーロウ「情熱の羊飼い」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Come live with me and be my love,
And we will all the pleasures prove,
That valleys, groves, hills, and fields,
Woods, or steepy mountain yields.

texts.title_ja: ダン「蚤」
ダン「悲しむことを禁じる別れの歌」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
As virtuous men pass mildly away,
And whisper to their souls to go,
Whilst some of their sad friends do say
The breath goes now

texts.title_ja: ハーバート「復活祭の翼」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Lord, who createdst man in wealth and store,
Though foolishly he lost the same,
Decaying more and more

texts.title_ja: ミルトン「リシダス」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Yet once more, O ye Laurels, and once more
Ye Myrtles brown, with Ivy never sere,
I come to pluck your Berries harsh and crude

texts.title_ja: ドライデン「アレクサンダーの饗宴」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
'Twas at the royal feast for Persia won
By Philip's warlike son—
Aloft in awful state

texts.title_original: Pope, The Rape of the Lock
texts.title_ja: ポープ『髪盗み』冒頭
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
What dire offence from amorous causes springs,
What mighty contests rise from trivial things,
I sing

texts.title_original: Gray, Elegy Written in a Country Churchyard
texts.title_ja: グレイ「田舎の墓地に詠める哀歌」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
The curfew tolls the knell of parting day,
The lowing herd wind slowly o'er the lea,
The plowman homeward plods his weary way,
And leaves the world to darkness and to me.

texts.title_ja: バーンズ「赤き、赤き薔薇」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
O my Luve is like a red, red rose
That's newly sprung in June;
O my Luve is like the melody
That's sweetly played in tune.

texts.title_ja: ブレイク「子羊」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Little Lamb, who made thee?
Dost thou know who made thee?
Gave thee life, and bid thee feed,
By the stream and o'er the mead

texts.title_ja: ブレイク「ロンドン」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
I wander thro' each charter'd street,
Near where the charter'd Thames does flow.
And mark in every face I meet
Marks of weakness, marks of woe.

texts.title_original: Wordsworth, I Wandered Lonely as a Cloud
texts.title_ja: ワーズワース「水仙」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
I wandered lonely as a cloud
That floats on high o'er vales and hills,
When all at once I saw a crowd,
A host, of golden daffodils

texts.title_ja: ワーズワース『序曲』第1巻冒頭
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Oh there is blessing in this gentle breeze,
A visitant that while it fans my cheek
Doth seem half-conscious of the joy it brings

texts.title_ja: コールリッジ「クビライ・カーン」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
In Xanadu did Kubla Khan
A stately pleasure-dome decree:
Where Alph, the sacred river, ran
Through caverns measureless to man
Down to a sunless sea.

texts.title_original: Shelley, Ode to the West Wind
texts.title_ja: シェリー「西風に寄す」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
O wild West Wind, thou breath of Autumn's being,
Thou, from whose unseen presence the leaves dead
Are driven, like ghosts from an enchanter fleeing

texts.title_ja: シェリー「ひばりに寄す」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Hail to thee, blithe Spirit!
Bird thou never wert,
That from Heaven, or near it,
Pourest thy full heart

texts.title_ja: キーツ「死を恐れるとき」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
When I have fears that I may cease to be
Before my pen has glean'd my teeming brain,
Before high-piled books, in charactery,
Hold like rich garners the full ripen'd grain

texts.title_original: Keats, La Belle Dame sans Merci
texts.title_ja: キーツ「無情な美女」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
O what can ail thee, knight-at-arms,
Alone and palely loitering?
The sedge has wither'd from the lake,
And no birds sing.

texts.title_ja: バイロン「暗闇」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
I had a dream, which was not all a dream.
The bright sun was extinguish'd, and the stars
Did wander darkling in the eternal space

texts.title_ja: バイロン『ドン・ジュアン』第1巻冒頭
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
I want a hero: an uncommon want,
When every year and month sends forth a new one,
Till, after cloying the gazettes with cant,
The age discovers he is not the true one

texts.title_ja: ゲーテ『西東詩集』
シラー「歓喜に寄す」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Freude, schöner Götterfunken,
Tochter aus Elysium,
Wir betreten feuertrunken,
Himmlische, dein Heiligtum!

texts.title_ja: ヘルダーリン「人生の半ば」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Mit gelben Birnen hänget
Und voll mit wilden Rosen
Das Land in den See,
Ihr holden Schwäne

texts.title_ja: ノヴァーリス『夜の讃歌』第1
texts.full_text_or_excerpt: Welcher Lebendige, Sinnbegabte, liebt nicht vor allen Wundererscheinungen des verbreiteten Raums um ihn, das allerfreuliche Licht

texts.title_ja: アイヒェンドルフ「月夜」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Es war, als hätt' der Himmel
Die Erde still geküßt,
Daß sie im Blütenschimmer
Von ihm nun träumen müßt'.

texts.title_ja: ラマルティーヌ「湖」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Ainsi, toujours poussés vers de nouveaux rivages,
Dans la nuit éternelle emportés sans retour,
Ne pourrons-nous jamais sur l'océan des âges
Jeter l'ancre un seul jour ?

texts.title_ja: ヴィニー「狼の死」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Les nuages couraient sur la lune enflammée
Comme sur l'incendie on voit fuir la fumée

texts.title_ja: ミュッセ「五月の夜」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Poète, prends ton luth ; le vin de la jeunesse
Fermente cette nuit dans les veines de Dieu

texts.title_ja: ネルヴァル「エル・デスディチャード（不幸者）」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Je suis le Ténébreux, – le Veuf, – l'Inconsolé,
Le Prince d'Aquitaine à la Tour abolie:
Ma seule Étoile est morte

texts.title_ja: ボードレール「旅への誘い」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Mon enfant, ma sœur,
Songe à la douceur
D'aller là-bas vivre ensemble!
Aimer à loisir

texts.title_ja: ボードレール「スプリーン LXXVIII」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Quand le ciel bas et lourd pèse comme un couvercle
Sur l'esprit gémissant en proie aux longs ennuis,
Et que de l'horizon embrassant tout le cercle
Il nous verse un jour noir plus triste que les nuits

texts.title_ja: ランボー「酔いどれ船」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Comme je descendais des Fleuves impassibles,
Je ne me sentis plus guidé par les haleurs
Des Peaux-rouges criards les avaient pris pour cibles
Les ayant cloués nus aux poteaux de couleurs.

texts.title_original: Verlaine, Il pleure dans mon cœur
texts.title_ja: ヴェルレーヌ「街に降る雨のように」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Il pleure dans mon cœur
Comme il pleut sur la ville;
Quelle est cette langueur
Qui pénètre mon cœur?

texts.title_ja: マラルメ「半獣神の午後」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Ces nymphes, je les veux perpétuer.
Si clair,
Leur incarnat léger, qu'il voltige dans l'air

texts.title_ja: マラルメ「海風」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
La chair est triste, hélas! et j'ai lu tous les livres.
Fuir! là-bas fuir! Je sens que des oiseaux sont ivres
D'être parmi l'écume inconnue et les cieux!

texts.title_ja: イェイツ「再臨」
イェイツ「ビザンチウムへ航海して」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
That is no country for old men. The young
In one another's arms, birds in the trees,
—Those dying generations—at their song,
The salmon-falls, the mackerel-crowded seas

texts.title_ja: エリオット『荒地』第1部冒頭
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
April is the cruellest month, breeding
Lilacs out of the dead land, mixing
Memory and desire, stirring
Dull roots with spring rain.

texts.title_ja: エリオット「うつろな人々」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
We are the hollow men
We are the stuffed men
Leaning together
Headpiece filled with straw. Alas!

texts.title_ja: パウンド『キャントス』第1歌
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
And then went down to the ship,
Set keel to breakers, forth on the godly sea, and
We set up mast and sail on that swart ship

texts.title_original: Stevens, Thirteen Ways of Looking at a Blackbird
texts.title_ja: スティーヴンス「黒鳥を見る13の方法」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Among twenty snowy mountains,
The only moving thing
Was the eye of the blackbird.

texts.title_ja: ウィリアムズ「赤い手押し車」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
so much depends
upon
a red wheel
barrow

texts.title_ja: H.D.「エウリュディケー」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
So you have swept me back,
I who could have walked with the live souls
above the earth,
I who could have slept among the live flowers

texts.title_ja: フロスト「行かれざりし道」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Two roads diverged in a yellow wood,
And sorry I could not travel both
And be one traveler, long I stood
And looked down one as far as I could

texts.title_ja: フロスト「雪降る夕暮れ森に佇む」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Whose woods these are I think I know.
His house is in the village though;
He will not see me stopping here
To watch his woods fill up with snow.

texts.title_ja: ハーディ「闇のツグミ」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
I leant upon a coppice gate
When Frost was spectre-grey,
And Winter's dregs made desolate
The weakening eye of day.

texts.title_ja: ホプキンス「斑(まだら)の美」
ブラウニング「亡き公爵夫人」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
That's my last Duchess painted on the wall,
Looking as if she were alive. I call
That piece a wonder, now: Frà Pandolf's hands
Worked busily a day, and there she stands.

texts.title_ja: テニスン「ユリシーズ」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
It little profits that an idle king,
By this still hearth, among these barren crags,
Match'd with an aged wife, I mete and dole
Unequal laws unto a savage race

texts.title_ja: アーノルド「ドーヴァー海岸」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
The sea is calm tonight.
The tide is full, the moon lies fair
Upon the straits;—on the French coast the light
Gleams and is gone

texts.title_original: Dickinson, Hope is the thing with feathers
texts.title_ja: ディキンソン「希望は羽あるもの」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
"Hope" is the thing with feathers –
That perches in the soul –
And sings the tune without the words –
And never stops – at all –

texts.title_original: Dickinson, The Brain - is wider than the Sky
texts.title_ja: ディキンソン「脳は空より広く」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
The Brain—is wider than the Sky—
For—put them side by side—
The one the other will contain
With ease—and You—beside

texts.title_ja: ホイットマン「おお艦長、わが艦長」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
O Captain! my Captain! our fearful trip is done,
The ship has weather'd every rack, the prize we sought is won,
The port is near

texts.title_ja: プーシキン「冬の朝」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Мороз и солнце; день чудесный!
Еще ты дремлешь, друг прелестный —
Пора, красавица, проснись:
Открой сомкнуты негой взоры

texts.title_ja: レールモントフ「帆」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Белеет парус одинокой
В тумане моря голубом!..
Что ищет он в стране далекой?
Что кинул он в краю родном?..

texts.title_ja: チュッチェフ「シレンティウム！」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Молчи, скрывайся и таи
И чувства и мечты свои —
Пускай в душевной глубине

texts.title_ja: アフマートワ『レクイエム』献辞
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Перед этим горем гнутся горы,
Не течет великая река,
Но крепки тюремные затворы,
А за ними «каторжные норы»

texts.title_ja: マンデリシュターム「トリスティア」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Я изучил науку расставанья
В простоволосых жалобах ночных.
Жуют волы, и длится ожиданье

texts.title_ja: ペソア「タバカリア」（カンポス異名）
texts.era_period: ポルトガル・モダニズム
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Não sou nada.
Nunca serei nada.
Não posso querer ser nada.
À parte isso, tenho em mim todos os sonhos do mundo.

texts.title_original: Antonio Machado, Caminante no hay camino
texts.title_ja: アントニオ・マチャード「旅人、道はない」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Caminante, son tus huellas
el camino y nada más;
caminante, no hay camino,
se hace camino al andar.

texts.title_ja: ロルカ「騎手の歌」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Córdoba.
Lejana y sola.
Jaca negra, luna grande,
y aceitunas en mi alforja.

texts.title_ja: リルケ「豹」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Sein Blick ist vom Vorübergehn der Stäbe
so müd geworden, daß er nichts mehr hält.
Ihm ist, als ob es tausend Stäbe gäbe
und hinter tausend Stäben keine Welt.

texts.title_ja: トラークル「グローデク」
texts.era_period: オーストリア表現主義
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Am Abend tönen die herbstlichen Wälder
Von tödlichen Waffen, die goldnen Ebenen
Und blauen Seen
